US Senator Vance Urges Republicans to Focus on National Issues

US Senator J.D. Vance has urged Republican voters in battleground states to 'nationalize' the upcoming midterm elections. He suggested focusing on broader national issues rather than local contests. Some reports indicate that during a Republican event, attendees chanted '48', a reference to the year 1948, potentially signifying a desire for a return to past political eras or policies. Vance himself reportedly did not wish to discuss potential 2028 presidential aspirations.
